text: TANECO is a company of the Tatneft Group: TANECO's own website describes the company as working to strengthen the Tatneft Group's competitive positions, and Tatneft's official list of group divisions and companies includes AO TANECO.
short: TANECO is Tatneft Group's refining company.

source.name: AO TANECO: official site
source.quote: АО «ТАНЕКО» – социально ориентированное динамично развивающееся предприятие, нацеленное на усиление долгосрочных конкурентных позиций Группы компаний «Татнефть»
source.note: Russian: 'AO TANECO is a ... company aimed at strengthening the long-term competitive positions of the Tatneft Group of companies.' Site footer: © ПАО «Татнефть».
